facts.form: noncellular, unreinforced multilayer film, presumably in rolls, not self-adhesive

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 3920 covers plates, sheets, film, foil and strip of plastics, noncellular and not reinforced, laminated, supported or similarly combined with other materials; lamination of one plastic to another plastic stays in 3920
Headings 3919 (self-adhesive) and 3921 (cellular/reinforced/combined with non-plastics) do not apply on the facts given

GRI 6 with chapter 39 principles (note 4 / subheading note 1 approach): a multi-polymer film goes to the subheading of the polymer predominating by weight; BOPP assumed to predominate (named first and usually the thicker layer) -> 3920.20 of polymers of propylene; suffix .55 other

classification.rationale: A laminate of BOPP and PET films is a noncellular, unreinforced plastic film of heading 3920. The 6-digit subheading depends on which polymer predominates by weight: polypropylene gives 3920.20 and PET gives 3920.62. The weight split is not stated. Assuming BOPP predominates, the code is 3920.20.00.55, consistent with NY K84976 (in force), which classified multilayer BOPP sheets in 3920.20.0000.
